# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/teams/{team}

Delete a team from a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-332`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| team | path | string | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — team not found
- **405** — repo is not owned by an organization
- **403** — user is not repo admin nor owner
- **422** — team was not added to repo

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.DeleteTeam | controller | delegate to changeRepoTeam(ctx, false) |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.changeRepoTeam | controller | check org ownership; check admin/owner permission; get team; check if has repo; call RemoveRepositoryFromTeam |
| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | repo_service.RemoveRepositoryFromTeam | service | check HasRepository; skip if IncludesAllRepositories; get repo by ID; within transaction: remove team_repo, decrement num_repos, recalculate access, remove watches for members who lost access |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Repository must be owned by an organization for team operations | validation | !ctx.Repo.Owner.IsOrganization() |
| Only repo admin or org owner can add/remove teams | authorization | !ctx.Repo.Owner.RepoAdminChangeTeamAccess && !ctx.Repo.Permission.IsOwner() |
| Cannot remove a team that is not assigned to the repository | validation | !add && !repoHasTeam |
| When removing team, unwatch repo for members who lost all access | business_logic | !HasAnyUnitAccess(ctx, member.ID, repo) |

### Error Paths

- **repo not owned by org** → changeRepoTeam → 405
- **user not admin/owner** → changeRepoTeam → 403
- **team not found** → getTeamByParam → 404
- **team not assigned to repo** → changeRepoTeam → 422

- **[P2] query_optimization**: Batch access check and watch removal for team members — *Impact: Reduce 2N queries to 2 batch queries for large teams*
